bio: Hi, I'm Seongsu. Thank you for stopping by! 👋 The spelling of my name in Korean is "성수" and it is pronounced as [sʌŋ-su:].

I am currently second year Ph.D. student in the AI department at KAIST, working with Professor [Sungsoo Ahn](https://sungsoo-ahn.github.io/) at the SPML Lab. I completed my M.S. in Artificial Intelligence at POSTECH. I am tentatively expected to graduate in Fall 2027.
My research interests include integrating AI into scientific research and using AI to uncover scientific facts.
I strongly believe AI can effectively reduce computational complexity in scientific problems and help discover new insights in fundamental sciences.
I am open to discussion, please feel free to reach out anytime!
